headline: Knee-high SSE dribble on a marginal angle — log it or skip it.
today: Barely 1.5ft at a marginal angle with cross wind all day, so there's not much to work with. If you want to get wet, morning before the WNW fills in is your least-junky window, and it's a log-only affair. Otherwise this is a coffee day.

daysToWatch.note: Still tiny at 1.6ft but it's a prime ESE angle with offshore dawn going glassy mid-morning — worth a longboard dawn patrol before the SSE onshore ruins it by afternoon.
South wind ramps to 23mph onshore — blown out and ugly, don't bother.

Biggest of the stretch at 3-plus feet with clean NW cross-off winds all morning. Short period and marginal angle keep it from being epic, but it's rideable and the best size you'll see — bring the shortboard or groveler.
